scope: PRE_NY_BUILD only; chronological second-half OOS; no rule selected

methodology.spike: existing opportunity-window structural forensic spike classification
methodology.chain: pre-entry structural flags already computed by opportunity-window structural forensic
methodology.ranking: deterministic pre-entry rank: structuralCount, then sequenceComplete, FVG retest, expansion, then entry time
methodology.dailyCap: select at most K ranked candidates per UTC calendar day; K=1..5
methodology.important: daily cap is a research filter, not a requirement to manufacture a signal; days with no qualifying setup remain no-trade
